text:
Maya Patel: Kicking off a customer story with Aperture Analytics — they agreed to a case study and a short webinar mention. Customer contact is Ana, she's available week of Apr 6. Need: interview, a short quote, legal release signed, and a small benchmark callout we can publish.

Ethan Liu: Thanks. Can someone confirm the benchmark numbers they want highlighted? I need exact config (model + Dedicated profile) to pull cost/latency numbers.

Priya Rao: I drafted the interview guide and the standard release. Dropping both here: https://drive.example.com/aperture-case-study (please don't edit the doc directly). Quick Qs look like: ```1) What problem did you try to solve? 2) How did Redwood change performance/ops? 3) Any metrics or cost signals to share? 4) Short quote (1-2 sentences) we can use on landing page.```

Sam O'Connor: I'll own getting the quote from Ana — asking for a 1-2 sentence soundbite after the interview. I can do the interview on Apr 7 if that's good for product/CS.

Tom Reyes: I'll pull the telemetry from Dedicated (project: aperture-prod) and calculate percent latency reduction and tokens/sec improvements. ETA EOD tomorrow. Heads-up: we saw ~40% median latency reduction on our internal test, but need to validate on their workload traces.

Nina Gomez: Legal here — please do not publish anything that implies PHI handling or that we processed personal health data. Ask the customer to sign our standard release and the marketing-specific addendum. I will review redlines. Also confirm that the customer entity name in the release is the legal company name.

Priya Rao: Noted. I'll send the release to Ana after the interview. Can we include a field like 'approved quote for press' in the release so signoff is explicit?

Nina Gomez: Yes, add a short checkbox: "I approve this quote for public use". Also include a simple opt-out for logo usage. That will make approvals faster.

Ethan Liu: For the benchmark callout language, let's avoid absolute claims. Suggest: "up to 3x cost reduction" and "median latency reduced by ~40%" unless Tom confirms exact numbers. Marketing prefers ranges.

Tom Reyes: Confirming I'll validate and return a short snippet like: "Up to 3x lower token cost and ~40% median latency reduction on Aperture's inference workload (Dedicated profile)." I'll attach metrics and test config.

Maya Patel: Great. Sam — once you get Ana's quote, can you paste it in-thread and tag Nina for legal signoff? We should aim to publish the case study + landing snippet the week of Apr 13.

Sam O'Connor: Yep. I'll ask for a short quote during the call and follow up if needed. Tagging @Priya for interviews scheduling.

Priya Rao: Scheduling poll sent to Ana and our team. Proposed slots Apr 7 10am or Apr 8 2pm PT. Please add availability.

MarCom Bot: Task created: "Aperture case study — interview scheduling" assigned to Priya, Sam, Tom. Due: 2026-04-03.

Ethan Liu: Also — this case study will feed the webinar narrative. We need to plan a short 25-min webinar + 10 min Q&A. Once quote is live, let's draft a join form that routes leads to the AE queue and tags the campaign as "Aperture_CaseStudy_Q2" in SFDC.

Maya Patel: Good call. Sam, can you coordinate with Sales Ops to set up the SFDC campaign and the lead routing? We need an automated Slack notification to #sales-inbound when someone registers.

Sam O'Connor: On it. I'll create the campaign and ask Ops to set the webhook for Slack notifications. Will confirm by EOD Thursday.

Nina Gomez: When you send the release to the customer, include the redline version and a short note explaining public quote vs. confidential data. Keep the legal text simple — customers respond faster.

Priya Rao: Will do. Anything else?

Ethan Liu: One more — please make sure we have a short (1-2 sentence) technical blurb for the landing page that ops can use for copy: e.g., "Using Redwood Dedicated, Aperture reduced inference latency and cut per-request costs." I'll draft it after Tom's numbers.

Maya Patel: Perfect. If no blockers, action items: Tom validates metrics (EOD tomorrow), Sam requests quote in interview (Apr 7/8), Priya schedules + runs interview, Nina prepares release redline, Sam creates SFDC campaign (EOD Thu). We'll reconvene here when Ana's quote is in. :thumbsup:

Tom Reyes: I'll post the raw numbers and config snippet in this thread when ready.

Sam O'Connor: Noted. I'll also include a short checklist for the publish flow so Legal & Comms can tick off approvals.

Priya Rao: Scheduled the interview for Apr 7 10am PT. Invite sent.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for approvals.

MarCom Bot: Reminder scheduled: "Follow up for Aperture quote" on 1763580000.
